Name: Elliott Dialogue for The Stardew Squad
Author: elee7420
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Elliott Dialogue for The Stardew Squad

[/b][/size][/center][center][size=4][b]✨ About This Mod
[/b][/size][/center]This mod adds 300+ lines of original dialogue for Elliott, written for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url] mod. It is a faithful character expansion that builds on Elliott's established canon personality while staying true to the beloved character development of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10243]Realistic Writer Elliott[/url]. The dialogue reveals a poetic, introspective, and romantically-minded companion who slowly learns to balance his artistic ideals with the warmth of real connection.

[line][center][size=4][b]
✨ What This Mod Does
[/b][/size][/center][list][list][/list][list][*] Adds 300+ lines of original, context-aware Elliott dialogue
[/list][list][*] Expands emotional depth while remaining fully in-character
[/list][list][*] Integrates seamlessly with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url] companion system
[/list][list][*] Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10243]Realistic Writer Elliott[/url]
[/list][list][*] Features location-specific dialogue for farm, mines, town, volcano, beach and more
[/list][list][*] Includes relationship-progressive dialogue across low hearts, high hearts, and spouse stages
[/list][list][/list][/list][line][center][size=4][b]
💬 Character Development
[/b][/size][/center]Based on the completed dialogue in the mod file, Elliott's character arc progresses through three distinct stages:[list][b]
Low Hearts (Acquaintance)[/b]Reserved, poetic, and slightly self-absorbed. He speaks in metaphors, observes the world through a writer's lens, and maintains a polite but formal distance. His humor is dry and intellectual, and he often seems more comfortable with ideas than with people.[b]High Hearts (Close Friend / Romantic)
[/b]More vulnerable and emotionally present. He shares his doubts about his writing, expresses genuine admiration for the farmer's practical skills, and reveals romantic interest through lyrical, earnest confession. His protective side emerges—though he’s more likely to defend with words than with force.[b]

Spouse
[/b]Still fundamentally Elliott—romantic, verbose, and prone to melodrama—but now grounded in shared domesticity. He’s a devoted partner who expresses love through poetic words, quiet companionship, and seeing the farmer as his muse. Marriage hasn’t made him less of a dreamer; it’s given his dreams a home. [/list][line][center][size=4][b]
📜 Dialogue Features[/b][/size]T

The mod includes comprehensive dialogue for various activities and locations:[size=4][b]
[/b][/size][/center]
[list][list][list][/list][list][*] Location-specific lines for farm, mines, town, house, volcano, beach, Secret Woods, and winter settings
[/list][list][*] Activity dialogue for attacking, lumbering, mining, watering, harvesting, foraging, fishing, and petting animals
[/list][list][*] Weather and seasonal dialogue (rain, winter)
[/list][list][*] Relationship-specific recruit and dismiss dialogue for each heart level
[/list][list][*] Idle conversation lines that reveal his evolving perspective and growing attachment
[/list][list][/list][/list][/list][line][center][size=4][b]
🔧 Compatibility & Notes
[/b][/size][/center][list][list][list][/list][list][*] Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardrew Squad[/url] by ThaliaFawnheart
[/list][list][*] Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10243]Realistic Writer Elliott[/url] or any other canon-friendly Elliott expansion mod
[/list][list][*] Safe to add to or remove from existing saves
[/list][list][*] All dialogue is original and written to complement—not replace—existing Elliott characterization
[/list][list][/list][/list][/list][line][center][size=4][b]
🛠 Future Plans
[/b][/size][/center]Future character packs are planned for:[list]  • Shane• Abigail• Emily• Penny[/list][line][center][size=4][b]
🌏 Localization Plans
[/b][/size][/center]Chinese translation is planned for all dialogue packs listed above.[line][center][size=4][b]
💙 Special Thanks
[/b][/size][/center]A huge thank you to [b]ThaliaFawnheart[/b], creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url], for making this mod possible.

Special thanks to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10243]Realistic Writer Elliott[/url] for deepening Elliott’s voice in the community. This dialogue expansion builds upon that thoughtful character work.

[line]
This project began as a personal passion to give Elliott more presence in
the world, especially when traveling alongside the farmer. I wanted to capture his lyrical introspection, his struggle between solitude and connection, his dry wit, and the tender, earnest heart beneath the poet's posture.

Enjoy your time with Elliott.  
Even the quietest shores hold the deepest stories.
